entity_raw.definition_raw:
You instill hope in the creatures you heal.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Channel, channel energy class feature, worshiper of a good deity.

Benefit(s): When you heal a creature by channeling positive energy, you also relieve its fear. If a creature you heal is shaken, that condition ends. If the creature is frightened, it becomes shaken instead. If the creature is panicked, it becomes frightened instead.
